svg.title: FlashDeconv workflow
svg.desc: FlashDeconv workflow, visually refined after independent review: consistent typography and rounded data connectors, inset routing, shared smooth tissue boundaries, explicit coefficient normalization, and a schematic probability ranking without an unsupported upper tick. Text and vector color fields remain editable; no raster image is embedded. Publication width: 183 mm.
